audit.whatIsWrong: Early text said 'his Mocking Shout slows you' as an unconditional threat.
audit.why: Mocking Shout reduces the attack damage of everyone around him, but it only slows enemies whose backs are turned to him. Facing him is a free answer to half the ability, and the old text gave you no way to play around it.
audit.corrected: Early phase and whys[1] now state the back-turned condition, which makes 'face him while you disengage' actionable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage was gated on Undying Rage with no cooldown, and Spinning Slash — the ability that actually decides whether he reaches you — carried no number at all.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80 and Spinning Slash 12/11/10/9/8. The lane is played on the 12s gap-close, not the two-minute ultimate.
audit.corrected: Spikes and cooldown block now carry Spinning Slash at 12s rank 1 and Undying Rage at 120s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly wrote 'Fury-stacked crit Spinning Slash autos', merging his passive, his crit and his dash into one thing.
audit.why: Battle Fury is the passive that converts Fury into crit chance; Spinning Slash is a separate dash. Merging them hides which one you are meant to bait. Twilight Shroud's real value here is that it makes you unable to be selected by attacks, so his auto chain simply stops.
audit.corrected: Passive and dash named separately; the shroud lines now say his attacks cannot select you rather than the vaguer 'breaks his auto-targeting'.

edits.before: With only Q and no Shroud yet, his Fury-stacked crit autos out-stat your kunai poke and his E lets him spin on top of any Five Point Strike you throw — concede the levels and last-hit from max Q range.
edits.after: With only Q and no Shroud yet, his Battle Fury crit autos out-stat your kunai poke and Spinning Slash (E) closes on any Five Point Strike you throw — concede the levels and last-hit from max Q range.

edits.before: Survive levels 1-3 last-hitting at the tip of Q range — Twilight Shroud and Perfect Execution are your only real answers to his Spinning Slash, and neither exists yet
edits.after: Survive levels 1-3 last-hitting at the tip of Q range — Twilight Shroud and Perfect Execution are your only answers to Spinning Slash, 12s at rank 1, and neither exists yet

edits.before: At 6, bait his E on cooldown, Shroud to break his auto-targeting, then Shuriken-Flip plus both R casts before Bloodlust's Fury heal restores him
edits.after: At 6, bait his E, Shroud so his attacks cannot select you, then Shuriken-Flip plus both R casts before Bloodlust's Fury heal restores him

edits.before: Mocking Shout to slow you, E onto you, and spin you down before your energy bar refills for a second combo
edits.after: Mocking Shout to slow you if your back is turned, then E on and spin you down before your energy refills

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his and you have to accept it — you have only Q, no Twilight Shroud, no sustain, so his Fury-stacked crit Spinning Slash autos out-stat your kunai and he spins on top of any Five Point Strike you fan. Don't walk up to throw a Q he can answer with a crit auto; last-hit at the very tip of Q range and eat a little harass. His Mocking Shout slows you and his E gap-closes, so never get caught flat-footed near the slow — once he's on you with Fury built, your energy bar can't out-trade him.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his and you have to accept it — you have only Q, no Twilight Shroud, no sustain, so his Battle Fury crit autos out-stat your kunai and Spinning Slash closes on any Five Point Strike you fan. Don't walk up to throw a Q he can answer with a crit auto; last-hit at the very tip of Q range and eat a little harass. Mocking Shout cuts your AD and only slows you if your back is turned, so face him while you back off — once he's on you with Fury built, your energy bar can't out-trade him.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 finally even out: Twilight Shroud lets you break his auto-targeting mid-spin and reset, and your Assassin's Mark empowered autos start punishing him if he steps up greedily without Fury banked. At 6 it tips your way — bait his E, drop Shroud so his autos lose the target, then Shuriken-Flip in and chain both casts of Perfect Execution. The missing-health execute on cast two is your one clean window to kill him before Bloodlust's Fury heal tops him back up, so commit the full combo or don't commit at all.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 finally even out: Twilight Shroud makes you unable to be selected by his attacks, so the auto chain stops mid-spin and you reset, and your Assassin's Mark empowered attacks punish a greedy step-up made without Fury banked. At 6 it tips your way — bait his E, 12s at rank 1, drop Shroud so his attacks lose you, then Shuriken-Flip in and chain both casts of Perfect Execution. The missing-health execute on cast two is your one clean window before Bloodlust's Fury heal tops him back up.

edits.before: He builds Fury fast and Mocking Shout into E lets him stick and trade while you still have no defensive tool to answer.
edits.after: He builds Fury fast, and Mocking Shout slows you only if you turn to run — face him, or he sticks with E and trades free.

edits.before: Still no Shroud to break his auto-targeting; his sustained crit autos beat your Q poke in any extended trade.
edits.after: Still no Shroud to make his attacks lose you; his sustained crit autos beat your Q poke in any extended trade.

edits.before: Undying Rage survives your two-cast R for 5s, so he tanks your full burst and crit-spins you down once his items are online.
edits.after: Undying Rage survives your two-cast R outright, so he tanks the full burst and crit-spins you down once his items are online.

edits.before: Anti-heal his crits — Q-poke, R after his R. Akali wins the Undying Rage cooldown windows.
edits.after: Anti-heal his crits — Q-poke, R after his R. Akali wins the Spinning Slash windows.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Tryndamere's Undying Rage is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Take it when Spinning Slash is down, 12s at rank 1.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Execute after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unkillable while it runs; 120s at rank 1. Only engage once it ends.

notes: Mocking Shout's slow is conditional on the target's back being turned — the old text sold it as an unconditional slow, which is the difference between a free disengage and a death. Spinning Slash (12/11/10/9/8) was never given a number anywhere despite being the ability that decides whether he reaches you.
